finding: Exact-current cursor/count/completion-chain adoption can make a signed renewal stale when an already-authorized pending block completes or ordinary observation advances during review. It preserves data but can still stall continuation.
required_behavior: Authenticate the signed predecessor as an immutable retained ancestor, without guessing a cursor or replacing evidence.
Retain intervening original-scope completions and pending intent authority; adopt the new reviewed scope at the next untouched boundary.
Recheck actual cumulative resource usage and approved monotonic bounds before new effects.
Reject unrelated, rewritten, missing or regressed predecessor evidence.
Add deterministic delayed-review and pending-old-scope completion controls.
limits: Mutable source design finding; no failing executable or production incident claimed.
No permission to rewrite an approval or weaken economic/runtime/recipient authority.
Frozen native source and qualification inputs remain unchanged.
